City of Chicago
                                                                    O2022-2460
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/20/2022
Sponsor(s):                    Martin (47)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 1757 W School St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                      ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

      SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RM-4.5, Residential Multi-Unit Distnct
symbols and indications as shown on Map No.9-H in the area bounded by

       West School Street; a line 25 feet east of and parallel to North Ravenswood
       Avenue; the public alley next south of and parallel to West School Street; and
       North Ravenswood Avenue;

to those of a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

       SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and publication.



Common Address:              1757 West School Street




                                                                          MATTIHEW MARTIN
                                                                         Alderman, 47th Ward
